title: TransactionEditView also uses /api/collections/transactions directly
body: The TransactionPaymentDetail component in src/ui/admin/TransactionEditView/index.tsx also fetches from /api/collections/transactions/{id} directly. This may also return 404 in certain contexts and should be migrated to a consistent admin API pattern.
rationale: Same pattern issue as RecentTransactionsWidget - client-side fetches to Payload REST API may fail with 404 in admin context
